description: Creates a credential vault session for a merchant and returns a secure URL where the customer can store their login credentials for that merchant. Stored credentials are used by checkouts created with options.useSavedCredentialToLogin = true. The URL is valid for a limited time (expiresIn, in minutes). REQUIRED FOLLOW-UP: immediately present the returned url as a clickable link so the customer can open it.

merchantDomain.description: Merchant website URL the credentials belong to e.g. 'https://saltiebeauty.com'

name: create_credential_session
